curriculum.course_title: Maryland College and Career Ready Standards for Mathematics, Grades 6-8
curriculum.note: Crosswalk documents re-domained 2010 CCSS strands into NOS, AT, GR, and DS. Legacy 2010 identifiers (e.g., 6.NS.*, 7.RP.*, 8.F.*) appear in the crosswalk's previous-standards column and are NOT new-framework expectation IDs.

source_notes: Expectation identifiers and statements were extracted from the official MSDE Grade 6/7/8 MCCRS crosswalk documents (adopted July 2025, implementation SY 2026-2027).
Scope summaries are editorial paraphrases of the 2025 MD Standards Statement column; reviewers must compare them with official wording.
Sub-skill letters (a, b, c, ...) under each standard are not enumerated here; the top-level standard is the inventory unit.

Crosswalk covers state standard identifiers; MSDE landing page records July 29, 2025 Board adoption, while crosswalks state only Adopted: July 2025. Per-grade document revision dates differ from the adoption date.
Grade 8 companion guide is Version 1, February 2026, verified on the official MSDE companion cover page; Grade 7 is Version 2, June 2026. Their revisions are distinct.

reconciliation.warning: This manifest inventories ALL 79 top-level Grade 6-8 expectations from the official crosswalks. The merged seed reconciliation covers only the 28 existing local seeds; provisional relations recorded here are copied from it and remain unaccepted. Legacy 2010-column identifiers must never be treated as new-framework expectations.

classification_legend.standards_mapped: A repository-specific seed row has a provisional recorded relation to this expectation; this does not mean the mapping is accepted or complete.
classification_legend.reviewed_skill: Independent mathematical approval must cover the exact atomic target and definition.
classification_legend.generator_available: A generator must target the exact reviewed identity; local content is not enough.
classification_legend.validated_practice: Practice must be independently validated against both expectation and skill scope.
classification_legend.assessment_ready: An accepted independent assessment contract must exist.
classification_legend.verified_mastery_evidence: Learner evidence is never inferred from mappings, generators, practice, or tests.
